post.headline: Key setup is part of operating the channel
post.subtext: Recipients can connect OpenPGP during onboarding so the intake path is configured before people rely on it.
post.image_alt_text: Social graphic showing the Hush Line desktop onboarding encryption step, where a recipient can look up a Proton Mail key or paste an OpenPGP public key. The post contrasts the myth that encryption setup is a one-time launch chore with the reality that key setup is part of operating a sensitive intake channel.
